subject: Scheduler handoff & ops for marketplace demo (cross-cloud runbook)
messages:
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, CloudWave SI <ops@cloudwave.io>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduler handoff & ops for marketplace demo

Hi team —

CloudWave's lead (Josef) confirmed a 60-minute joint demo for Redwood via the AWS Marketplace listing, but asked for a short ops handoff before the customer-facing run. They'd like to reserve two 60-min windows next week that work across PST/CEST/APAC. Can we align availability and finalize the runbook? Key constraints:

- Redwood: need an SA + Solutions Engineer (30m of technical deep-dive, then 30m Q&A)
- CloudWave SI: will present an integration slice and handle procurement questions (15m)
- AWS Marketplace: needs 5–10m to confirm listing details and entitlements

Proposed slots (all shown in UTC for clarity):
- Tue 2027-09-21 16:00–17:00 UTC (AM PST, late afternoon CEST)
- Wed 2027-09-22 09:00–10:00 UTC (evening APAC, early morning PST)

I attached a draft runbook (redwood-playbook-runbook-v1.pdf) and a placeholder calendar invite. Please reply with preferred slot and who will own each agenda segment. I'll own the logistics and the AWS coordination.

Thanks,
Vanessa
VP Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-playbook-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Josef Martinez <josef@cloudwave.io>, AWS Marketplace PM <marketplace-aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduler handoff & ops for marketplace demo

Thanks Vanessa — quick notes:

- I can cover the SA piece. Prefer Tue 21 at 16:00 UTC. That hits our team's preferred afternoon slot.
- Karthik: can you take the Solutions Engineer deep dive? If so we'll split the technical portion 30/30.
- Soojin: can you confirm if you can be on the call to surface any billing/contract questions the customer may ask? AWS PM: can you confirm availability and whether we should block a short pre-call with marketplace team?

If we lock Tue we'll send a formal calendar invite and include a 15-minute pre-call for internal alignment 30 minutes prior.

—Marcus
Senior Sales Director
Redwood Inference

Marcus — I can take the solutions-deep dive. Confirming Tue 21 16:00 UTC works for me. Quick ask: can we get the expected dataset or sample integration flow ahead of time (S3 bucket name or sample payload)? I want to prepare a short reproducible demo.

Also flagged a small ops constraint: our GPU-backed sandbox will be available, but we need the CloudWave integration key before EOD 2027-09-17. Josef, can you share that? If not, we should switch to the Wed slot.

Thanks,
Karthik
Solutions Engineer
